items.claim: Zealand Pharma oplyste i selskabsmeddelelse nr. 46/2026 at selskabet i uge 36 købte 183.000 egne aktier, og at det derefter besidder i alt 3.916.842 egne aktier svarende til ca. 5,47 pct. af aktiekapitalen.

Zealand Pharma meddelte at adm. direktør Adam Steensberg deltager i en fireside chat på Morgan Stanleys 24. årlige Global Healthcare Conference i New York den 16. september 2026, og selskabet beskriver sig selv som "a biotechnology company focused on advancing medicines for obesity and metabolic health".
items.source: Zealand Pharma A/S, pressemeddelelse; IR-kontakt angivet som Eric Rojas, Vice President og Head of Investor Relations

items.claim: Zealand Pharma oplyste i selskabsmeddelelse nr. 47/2026 at aktiekapitalen er forhøjet med nominelt DKK 31.247 som følge af udnyttelse af warrants under et af selskabets medarbejderwarrantprogrammer, og at aktiekapitalen efter registrering udgør 71.610.005 aktier à nominelt DKK 1.

Zealand Pharma meddelte, at EMA's CHMP har afgivet positiv udtalelse med anbefaling af markedsføringstilladelse til Zeydovio (glepaglutide) mod korttarmssyndrom hos voksne, og at EU-Kommissionen ventes at træffe endelig afgørelse inden for ca. 67 dage.
items.source: Zealand Pharma A/S, selskabsmeddelelse via GlobeNewswire; David Kendall, MD, Chief Medical Officer, udtalte at «The positive opinion for Zeydovio is the first major advancement in short bowel syndrome treatment in Europe in more than a decade»

items.claim: Zealand Pharma oplyste om transaktioner i uge 37 2026 under selskabets aktietilbagekøbsprogram og anførte, at programmet gennemføres senest 31. oktober 2026, samt at selskabet herefter besidder ca. 5,82 % af aktiekapitalen i egne aktier.
items.source: Zealand Pharma A/S, selskabsmeddelelse via GlobeNewswire; investorkontakter Eric Rojas (VP, Head of Investor Relations) og Neshat Anis Ahmadi (Investor Relations Manager)

items.claim: Zealand Pharma announced it had initiated the registrational global Phase 3 ZUPREME programme (ZUPREME-3, -4 and -5, around 7,000 participants) of petrelintide for chronic weight management in people with overweight or obesity.

Chief Medical Officer David Kendall said the Phase 3a programme is designed to confirm petrelintide's "first-choice potential", supported by clinically meaningful double-digit weight reduction and a tolerability profile that supports long-term adherence.
items.source: David Kendall, MD, Chief Medical Officer, Zealand Pharma

items.claim: Zealand Pharma said the Phase 3a programme's three trials are designed to support marketing applications for petrelintide monotherapy, with percentage change in body weight to week 64 as the primary endpoint, run in partnership with Roche.
items.source: Zealand Pharma A/S, release text as carried by BioSpace

items.claim: Zealand Pharma reported weekly transactions under its ongoing share buy-back programme for week 38 2026 (company announcement no. 49/2026) and stated a treasury holding of 4,495,842 shares, around 6.28% of the share capital.
items.source: Zealand Pharma A/S, stock-exchange announcement no. 49/2026

items.claim: Reuters, in syndication, reported that Zealand Pharma's short bowel syndrome drug won backing from the EU panel, with a European Commission decision expected in roughly 67 days.

RTTNews reported that the CHMP recommended marketing authorisation for Zeydovio in adults with short bowel syndrome on the basis of Phase 3 EASE-1 data, with the matter now going to the European Commission.
Investing.com reported that Zealand Pharma gained EU panel backing for its short bowel syndrome drug on the basis of Phase 3 EASE-1 data versus placebo.
Investing.com reported that Zealand Pharma launched its Phase 3 obesity trials for petrelintide, spanning three studies and around 7,000 participants.

AllSci reported that Zealand launched the ZUPREME Phase III programme for the amylin analogue petrelintide in overweight and obesity, highlighting discontinuation rates said to be comparable to placebo.
